post.description:
Initiate a WordPress connection for a project.

Creates a short-lived handshake token, then returns a redirect URL that opens
the AiShopHelper plugin page on the user's WordPress admin with the token and
callback URL pre-filled.

Args:
    project_id (UUID): The project to connect WordPress to.
    body (WordpressStartBody): Contains the WordPress site_url.
    current_user (User): The authenticated user (must be org member).
    session (SessionDep): The database session.

Returns:
    WordpressStartResponse: JSON with redirect_url for the frontend to navigate to.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 if the project does not exist.
    HTTPException: 403 if the user is not a member of the project's org.

get.description:
Handle the browser redirect from the WordPress plugin after the user approves.

Validates the handshake token, stores the encrypted app password, deletes the
token, then redirects the browser to the configured success or failure page.

This endpoint is reached by a browser redirect — no Authorization header is sent.
The handshake token is the only authentication mechanism.

Args:
    session (SessionDep): The database session.
    token (str): The short-lived handshake token generated by the start endpoint.
    app_password (str): The WordPress application password created by the plugin.
    site_url (str): The WordPress site root URL echoed back by the plugin.
    user (str): The WordPress username that created the app password.

Returns:
    RedirectResponse: Redirects to WP_SUCCESS_FRONTEND_URL or WP_ERROR_FRONTEND_URL.

Return the WordPress connection status for a project.

Args:
    project_id (UUID): The project to check.
    current_user (User): The authenticated user (must be org member).
    session (SessionDep): The database session.

Returns:
    WordpressStatusResponse: Connected flag plus site_url and username (never the password).

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 if the project does not exist.
    HTTPException: 403 if the user is not a member of the project's org.

post.description:
Forward a blog-writer workflow call to n8n, injecting the WordPress auth token server-side.

Args:
    project_id (UUID): The project whose WordPress connection provides credentials.
    body (WordpressProxyBody): workflow name (titles|generate) + arbitrary payload dict.
    current_user (User): The authenticated user (must be org member).
    session (SessionDep): The database session.

Returns:
    WordpressProxyResponse: status_code plus parsed JSON data or raw text on non-JSON responses.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 409 if no WordPress connection exists for the project.
    HTTPException: 400 if the requested workflow name is not recognised.
    HTTPException: 404/403 if project not found or user not a member.
